explanation: In math reasoning, fires on a token inside the second of two parallel statements that reuses the template of the one just before it ("$x$ is not a multiple of 5. $y$ is", "Second term", "consecutive even ... consecutive odd integers", "6_8 ... 7_8", "5 upper class ... 10 lower class"). Moderate excerpts are weak firings on assorted digits and symbols in formulas without a visible parallel.
